blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine National Police (PNP) deployed personnel and vehicles to assist commuters and maintain peace and order as transport groups hold a three-day strike over rising fuel prices. In a statement on Monday, PNP chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. ordered police units to increase their presence at transport terminals, major roads, convergence points, and other areas where passenger volume is expected to rise, or disruptions may occur. “Our police units are prepared to maintain peace and order while providing assistance to commuters who may be affected by the transport strike,” said Nartatez.
